sections.heading: Fictional campus Wi-Fi access
sections.text: This is a synthetic training example, not an approved campus policy. In this fictional environment, demo-campus is the practice network for students and staff. Demo-guest is for visitors. Access problems that persist after the documented check should be described in a support draft; the draft is not submitted automatically.

guides.title: Demo-campus Wi-Fi credential error on Windows

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: Demo-campus Wi-Fi stopped working on Windows. A demo credential error prevents this laptop from connecting to the wireless campus network. Try reconnecting in the fictional training environment.
steps: Open the Wi-Fi settings on your Windows device.
Select the fictional demo-campus network and disconnect once.
Reconnect to demo-campus using the demonstration account in your training environment. Never share its password here.

workflow.prompt: Does the task work now, or what is still blocking you?
workflow.explanation: This check uses only the steps shown in this synthetic guide. Try it only when it fits your setup, then report the result. If access or permissions prevent it, stop and describe the blocker.

sections.heading: Fictional staff Wi-Fi support process
sections.text: This is synthetic staff-only training content, not an approved campus procedure. A staff reviewer can compare the reported time and affected network with an incident record. Students should describe the affected device and error in their support draft.
